messages:
kai: Quick note from the Crossbeam LoRA bring-up. Ran 25-invoice quickpack + a 60-case stress set. Base(redwood/xl-7b fp16), crossbeam-lora-r1 fp16, crossbeam quant int8/int4. Summary: int8 OK, int4 has decimal truncation and hyphen-split on invoice IDs.
emma: paste the short table and one example pls.
kai: short table: 
```
model                         EM   F1   num_halluc  fmt_diff
redwood/xl-7b_fp16            86%  91%  1.2%        2/250
crossbeam-lora-r1_fp16        87%  92%  1.0%        1/250
crossbeam-lora-r1_int8        86%  91%  1.8%        4/250
crossbeam-lora-r1_int4        81%  87%  7.6%       18/250
```

kai: example: prompt expects "$3,210.40" -> int4 outputs "3210.4 dollars" (drops trailing zero) or "three thousand two hundred ten" in some runs. Hyphenated invoice ids like "INV-12-345" sometimes token-split to "INV - 12 - 345" which breaks downstream parsers.
ravi: token/embed check?
kai: yes: mean embed delta for comma/dot/$/INV token cluster = 0.029 (int4) vs 0.003 (int8). KV-cache mismatch noticed in streaming path for a few traces.
zane: pipeline used? merge before quant?
kai: merge -> clip -> quant (group=128, calib=1024) using blockwise4. command snippet: 
```
merge: tools/merge_lora --base redwood/xl-7b --lora crossbeam-lora-r1 --out /tmp/crossbeam
quant: tools/quantize --model /tmp/crossbeam --bits 4 --group 128 --calib 1024 --method blockwise
```

emma: two quick mitigations: 1) try quant-first then graft LoRA, 2) small post-quant logit-bias for numeric tokens. Also try group=64 + calib=2048.
ravi: I'll add 40 more edge cases (trailing zeros, negative, parentheses, hyphens) and run overnight.
qa-bot: queued expanded quickpack. Block thresholds: num_halluc > 3.5% or fmt_diff > 10/250. Current int4 fmt_diff = 18/250 -> block candidate.
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked for `crossbeam-lora-r1_int4` until follow-up. :no_entry_sign:
zane: I'll try graft-on-quant and post results here. kai: thanks — will share kernel logs if streaming fallbacks replicate. reconvene AM. :coffee:
